runs.name: AXIA Energia S.A.; OTC ADS AXIAY (common) and AXICY (class C preferred), one share per ADS, B3 AXIA3 and AXIA7, SEC CIK 0001439124, Rio de Janeiro, 20-F filer under IFRS in reais until the Form 15F of 2026-08-07, formerly Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras S.A. - Eletrobras, renamed 2026-04-15; Brazil's largest generator (43,872.3 MW, 17% of national capacity) and largest transmission company; class B preferred exchanged 2025-12-22, class B1 preferred exchanged into common 2026-06-10 on the Novo Mercado migration, ADSs delisted from the NYSE (Form 25 of 2026-07-27); the IE Madeira and IE Garanhuns swap with ISA Energia signed March 2026; the 20-F names no rival, CEMIG and COPEL chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **R$ 59.49** (AXIA3, close 2026-10-16; AXIA7 R$ 59.99; ADS AXIAY US$ 11.63; aggregator, flagged), PTAX 5.0826 BRL per USD for 2026-10-16 (Banco Central do Brasil). Shares 2,775,952,565 outstanding (2,396,166,943 common and 379,785,622 class C preferred, both sharing in earnings) from the company's own September 2026 share-capital table on its investor-relations site, the company having ended SEC reporting; an unreconciled gap of about 115 million shares against the year-end count after the 1.1 conversion, declared. Sovereign **12.87%**, Tesouro Nacional NTN-F 2037 purchase rate of 2026-10-15 (issuing authority; nominal, chosen to match Q7's nominal discounting; NTN-B 2060 real 6.73% beside). Read from the FY2025 20-F (0001439124-26-000013), the FY2024 20-F (0001410578-25-000792), the FY2023 20-F (0001104659-24-052084), the FY2021 20-F (0001104659-22-057076, XBRL only), the 2Q26 release (6-K 0001292814-26-004087) and the Form 15F (0001292814-26-004140); 2024 operating cash R$ 12,385,583 thousand and owners' equity checked to the filed statements. `tools/run.py` produced nothing for this IFRS filer; every figure hand-built. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 3.D, 4 and 5, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: hydro volume known, transmission revenue regulated and inflation-indexed; the free-market energy price sent to Q2 and Q7. **Q2 IN on the deciding part**: transmission at 65% of five-year segment operating profit (about 54% with regulatory remeasurements and the Eletronuclear loss taken out), a regulated franchise carried to Q3 as a second best; narrowing at the regulator's hand (approved transmission revenue down 5.9% in 2025 after ANEEL cut the RBSE component by R$ 1.4bn, a TCU review pending); generation a commodity, realized contract price about R$ 245 to R$ 181 per MWh 2023 to 2025; return on equity 2017 to 2025 AXIA 8.7%, CEMIG 18.5%, COPEL 12.5%, against an average long sovereign of 10.65%. **Q3 weighs against**: about 5% on R$ 209bn of capital employed, return on book equity 6.0% average 2021 to 2025. **Q4 weighs against, not a STOP**: income dependent on regulatory remeasurement and deferred-tax judgment (deferred tax assets trebled in 2025, a R$ 7.0bn pre-tax loss reported as a R$ 6.6bn profit), recurring one-time charges, EBITDA featured. **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for, modestly**: the chairman's companies under contract to the company, amounts undisclosed. **Q6 Part A weighs against narrowly, Part B undecided**: the 10% voting cap and golden share, class C preferred redemptions priced at market. **Q7 OUT on the floor and above the top of the range**: the 2022 concession payment (about R$ 31.9bn, grant bonus R$ 26.6bn) left out under (a); owner cash 2021 to 2025 R$ 8,388M a year all-equity (literal window R$ 2,001M), R$ 4,738M equity-only (literal -R$ 1,649M); 17.2% growth capped by (f) to revenue growth of 4.49%; Law 14,182/2021 obligations of R$ 43.8bn counted in net debt and disposal proceeds counted once, both CONVENTIONS of the run; value range **-R$ 7.37 to R$ 0.73 a share all-equity** (US$ -1.45 to 0.14 per ADS), equity-only R$ 11.25 to R$ 14.09; expected return 3.6% to 5.1% central, 8.2% in the most favourable stress, all below the floor and the sovereign; fair price **R$ 5.75 all-equity (US$ 1.13 per ADS)**, R$ 16.42 equity-only (US$ 3.23). Q8 to Q12 not reached; after the stop: borrowings R$ 74.3bn at 2025-12-31, R$ 21.5bn of guarantees for investees, litigation R$ 19.9bn provisioned and R$ 55.6bn possible. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing of fifteen other 2026-10-18 run names, AYI and ARCB folder names and the AVA box line in the opening git context, the memory index, the lock file; nothing about this company seen; none used. Commits 359ef1aa (Step 0, Q1), 6b4917a6 (Q2), 16d11e65 (Q3), 26f21f50 (Q4), fd38ba0a (Q5), 36540916 (Q6), c794300f (Q7, Q6 line written back), 1d2b382d (box, after the stop, self-audit, gaps). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 83 ids, 103 fragments, no problem; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cites.py` no missing id, 97 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the ten-percent floor sits below the BRL sovereign of 12.87%, so the fair price is a price at which the buyer earns less than the Tesouro; no currency rule for the floor; (2) a concession renewal payment fits neither (a) nor (c); (3) debt-like regulatory obligations outside the net-debt definition; (4) finite concessions (2042 transmission, 2052 generation) against zero growth for ever; (5) the parts threshold on accounting or cash profit; (6) the regulated-return exception at Q2 leaves no STOP on returns below the risk-free rate before Q7; (7) `tools/run.py` cannot read an IFRS 20-F in reais. Armed at US$ 1.13 per ADS (the all-equity fair price at PTAX 5.0826). Could not get: the share-count gap, the chairman's contract amounts, rivals' unit generation costs, 3Q26 results.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor and above the top of the range (AXIA Energia S.A., formerly Eletrobras, ADS AXIAY, B3 AXIA3, SEC reporting ended by Form 15F 2026-08-07; Brazil's largest generator and transmitter; Q1 IN; Q2 IN on transmission as a regulated second best, narrowing at ANEEL's hand; Q3 against, about 5% on capital against a 12.87% sovereign; Q4 against, not a STOP; Q5 integrity IN, ability for; Q6 Part A narrowly against, Part B undecided; value range -R$ 7.37 to R$ 0.73 all-equity at R$ 59.49, expected return 3.6% to 5.1%, fair R$ 5.75 all-equity (US$ 1.13 per ADS), R$ 16.42 equity-only; no citation slip; not held; armed at US$ 1.13; framework gaps for the operator: the ten-percent floor below a higher sovereign, a concession renewal payment under (a) and (c), regulatory obligations as debt, finite concessions, the parts threshold measure, no STOP on sub-sovereign regulated returns before Q7)
runs.fair_label: AXIAY v5 fair price, all-equity, per ADS (one share per ADS) at PTAX 5.0826 (2026-10-16): $1.13 (R$ 5.75 a share; equity-only R$ 16.42, ADS $3.23). Run 2026-10-18 (Test Runs/2026-10-18 Run - AXIAY AXIA Energia.md; OUT at Q7 at R$ 59.49, ADS US$ 11.63; central value range -R$ 7.37 to R$ 0.73 at the 12.87% NTN-F 2037). Not a buy: any price below fair is read as cheap by the operator; a hit means re-run.
